unit.label: Share of land area in drought (moderate or worse)

source.publisher: U.S. Drought Monitor (National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA and NOAA)
source.dataset: Drought severity statistics by area, cumulative (D1 to D4)

howToRead: Counts land in moderate (D1), severe (D2), extreme (D3) or exceptional (D4) drought. Abnormally dry (D0) areas are not counted.
Maps are drawn weekly by climate scientists from rainfall, soil moisture, streamflow and on-the-ground reports, valid as of each Tuesday.
title: Drought by state
caveats: The Drought Monitor blends data with expert judgment, so it is an assessment, not a single measurement.
The national figure covers the 48 contiguous states.
description: Share of each state's land area in moderate drought or worse, each week since 2000.
